question: Who created FORTRAN - the first high-level computer programming language?
solution:
The correct answer is __**John Backus.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• FORTRAN is the first high-level programming language developed by **John Backus** in 1957.
 
• It was basically designed to write programs for high-performance computing.
 
• FORTRAN is a programming language that is used for numeric computation and scientific computing.
 
• It stands for **FORmula TRANslation.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Netscape Navigator was the first commercial Web browser launched in 1994.
 
 
• It was based of the Mosaic browser and was created by a team led by **Marc Andreessen,** a programmer who co-wrote the code for Mosaic.
 
 
 
• **Oracle** was started by **Larry Ellison**, Bob Miner and Ted Oates on 16 June 1977.
